tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 1.Pre-Qualification Criteria-Please refer Annexure C1 for Pre qualification criteria2.The bidder should undertake to supply the ordered quantity as per the delivery schedule provided.3.The Tender must fulfill all the statutory requirements.4.Tenderer who have been blacklisted by any of the Government Organization/ Public Sector undertaking for breach of contract shall not be considered.5.If the supply and quality performance are not satisfactory in respect of previous/past supplies, the offers of such firms will dis-qualified.6.Commercial Evaluation Criteria, Payment Schedule, Specifications, Warranty, SLA, Scope of Work, other terms & conditions and RFP,: Please refer Annexure-C, D, E, F and Annexure-G (Previous Experience Details) 1

Annexure-A1 duly filled, sealed & signed

Any other documents in respect of fulfilling Prequalification criteria and other Terms and conditions of tender.

None of the bidders, either the sole bidder or each of the member in case of a consortium should be declared bankrupt or in the process of insolvency proceedings. NSIC Certificate-To avail exemption from EMD

Surveillance system in Police Department or projects of State or Central or Union Territory Government Departments for the purpose of surveillance of Process with minimum of cumulative of 1000 cameras from maximum of four projects.
Technical Compliance to Tender Specifications

The Bidder should have a registered office and service centres in Karnataka or shall establish the same within 60 days from the date of issue of Purchase Order within the jurisdiction of KSRTC. Office Address and List of service centres in the company letter head signed by the authorized signatory.
The bidder should have an average annual turnover of minimum INR 9 crores for preceding continuous three years-i.e for 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

The bidder should have an average annual turnover of minimum INR 9 crores in the preceding three financial years. Submit Audited financial statements for preceding continuous three years i.e.2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26
